name: Alphalete - SEO Baseline 2026-07-22
body:
> Report · Alphalete · 2026-07-22

# Summary
A 10-page TAG baseline that "locks in" the measured state of the site on Jul 22 2026, so later progress is reported as a delta against these numbers. Sources: Search Atlas (OTTO, Site Audit #144030, Site Explorer, Rank Tracker, GBP), GSC, and a direct crawl of all 134 sitemap URLs.

# Headline scores (Search Atlas, refreshed Jul 20)
Overall 40, Technical 93, Content 30, Authority 2, UX signals 36.

# Key findings
- **Technical is effectively done (93/100)** and the OTTO noindex blocker is resolved: 134 of 134 sitemap URLs return 200, none noindex, all self-canonical. Blog move to `/blog/` resolved.
- **Traffic:** only 47 real US clicks in 90 days; every meaningful impression came from blog content. All 42 local pages combined: 0 impressions.
- **Rank tracker:** 14 keywords, 12 not ranking; only the brand term (#1) and a hydro cost term (#28). The tracker pointed at a stale pre-move URL.
- **Authority 2/100:** 26 backlinks from 20 referring domains, 0 legitimate. The profile is PBN and Fiverr spam by anchor text. Recommendation: real acquisition plan plus a disavow review.
- **Local page duplication:** two camera pages (Simla and Matheson) about 95% identical with the city removed. The 12 already-rewritten commercial metro pages were also at 0 impressions, raising the consolidate-vs-rewrite question.
- **GBP:** 16 reviews (4.94), 0 replied, 52.4% complete, score 58, 0 citations, average map rank 19, 8 open profile tasks, automations off.
- **Site audit:** 251 URLs, 3,017 issues; notable: 195 redirecting internal links, 29 pages with multiple H1s, 45 non-indexable URLs in the sitemap, 6 sitemap URLs that 301.
- **OTTO:** 425 issues, 183 deployed, 242 pending (schema 86, Twitter cards 51, knowledge graph 44, trust 30 pending). Pending heading/meta items were mostly on low-value URLs that should be noindexed.

# Recommended sequencing (from the file)
1. Reply to all 16 GBP reviews and complete the profile. 2. Build local citations. 3. Start genuine link acquisition. 4. Disavow review of the PBN cluster. 5. Decide consolidate vs rewrite for local pages. 6. Deploy OTTO schema (86 items). 7. Remove 6 redirecting sitemap URLs. 8. Expand rank tracking beyond 14 keywords.

# Status
GBP work later moved to the Agency owner (hands off). Local pages were restructured to 44 root city pages in August.
